title: The Illusion of Success
content: Everything seems sweeter at first, and then we chase after other sweet things. Whatever sweetness comes next. There is no victory over this. There is no search for this. When it is no longer there, if it was ever there at all. You are inside. You are it. There is no search for 'seek' that one can say, as you are it.
raw_text: Koi bhi cheez dur se sona hoti hai pass mai aate hi mitti banjati hai. Fir hum dusre cheez, dusre sone ke peeche jate hai. Jo fir se mitti banjauegi. Pr parmatma vaisi cheez nai hai. Usse koi conquer nai kr sakta. Usse koi dhund nai sakta. Kyse dhunde, jab vo tumare pass hi nai. Tum are andar nai. Tum hi ho. Usse koi 'khoj' kyse bolsakta hai jo tum hi ho.
